about: What WebhookVault itself does for each provider: the signature header its preset reads, where it finds the event name, the label of the secret field, and whether it checks the signature. Read from WebhookVault's provider catalogue, signature presets and sample library on the date below. These are facts about WebhookVault, not about the provider; the provider's own facts are in data/providers/<slug>.json.

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.scheme: HMAC-SHA256 hex over "t.body" from the t and v1 values, 5 minute tolerance

github.name: GitHub
github.scheme: HMAC-SHA256 hex of the raw body, prefixed sha256=
github.setupPath: Repository or organisation Settings > Webhooks > Add webhook (content type application/json)

shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.scheme: HMAC-SHA256 base64 of the raw body

woocommerce.name: WooCommerce
woocommerce.scheme: HMAC-SHA256 base64 of the raw body
woocommerce.setupPath: WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > Webhooks > Add webhook

slack.name: Slack
slack.scheme: HMAC-SHA256 hex over "v0:timestamp:body" with X-Slack-Request-Timestamp, prefixed v0=, 5 minute tolerance
slack.setupPath: api.slack.com > Your app > Event Subscriptions > Request URL

discord.name: Discord
discord.scheme: Ed25519 over timestamp + body from X-Signature-Ed25519 and X-Signature-Timestamp, verified with the application public key
discord.setupPath: Discord saves an Interactions Endpoint URL only after its signed PING check, which a capture URL cannot answer. Register your own handler there and have it relay each interaction to this URL (the Discord guide: https://webhookvault.net/providers/discord/)

twilio.name: Twilio
twilio.scheme: HMAC-SHA1 base64 over the public URL plus the sorted form parameters
twilio.setupPath: Console > Phone Numbers > Manage > Active numbers > your number > Messaging configuration > A message comes in

sendgrid.name: SendGrid
sendgrid.scheme: ECDSA P-256 over timestamp + body, verified with the public key

resend.name: Resend
resend.scheme: Standard Webhooks: HMAC-SHA256 base64 over "id.timestamp.body" from the svix-* headers, whsec_ secret, 5 minute tolerance

paddle.name: Paddle
paddle.scheme: HMAC-SHA256 hex over "ts:body" from the ts and h1 values, 5 minute tolerance
paddle.setupPath: Paddle > Developer tools > Notifications > New destination

paypal.name: PayPal
paypal.scheme: Certificate-chain signature (PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG); WebhookVault does not check this scheme yet, so a capture shows the verdict as unverifiable with the scheme named
paypal.setupPath: Developer Dashboard > Apps and Credentials > your app > Webhooks

lemonsqueezy.name: Lemon Squeezy
lemonsqueezy.scheme: HMAC-SHA256 hex of the raw body
